verdict.rationale: Ramp's Developer API is path-versioned: endpoints sit under /developer/v1/, and the canonical OpenAPI document is published as "Ramp Developer API" v1 with 174 paths. Nothing in the evidence documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version-migration guidance, so only half the story is covered. Missing for 10: documented deprecation/sunset policy, changelog or version-lifecycle guidance, evidence of multiple supported versions or migration paths, independent corroboration.
